content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Collins

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Granite PM Academy will review your background to ensure you meet PMI's prerequisites before enrollment, so you can proceed with confidence toward certification.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Fort Collins cohorts are designed for working professionals; you'll master PMBOK® fundamentals, real-world applications, and exam strategies in a structured, interactive environment.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission to PMI.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and one-on-one coaching to strengthen your readiness. You'll schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner and take it at a proctored testing center or online.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, you'll earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, and community involvement. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing credential maintenance.
